rows.title_full: AN ACT PROHIBITING POLITICAL DYNASTIES
rows.abstract: "Anti-Political Dynasties Act of 1992" Defines the term "POLITICAL DYNASTY." States  that no person shall  succeed in any public office, be elected or appointed  to any  elective or appointive office,  nor shall assume any  elective office where hisfamily member  or relative  is the  incumbent or  is occupying an elective or appointive position. Does not apply to the elective office  for vice mayor, members of the Sangguniang Panlung- sod or Bayan, Punong Barangay and members  of the Sangguniang Barangay. States further that no elective or appoin- tive officials shall   be eligible for appointment or designation to any public office after his tenure. * * *
